title: Architecture version 2
decision: Adopt the version 2 architecture: API and worker as a modular monolith in Python, a React front end serving Mini App, web panel and admin panel, PostgreSQL primary and standby on two servers in Uzbekistan with manual failover, row-level tenant isolation, a self-hosted file store, and SMS and online payment adapters switched off
context: Rewritten for PRD version 2 after the change of direction (DEC-012, DEC-013). By founder instruction the agent decided open points without stopping; the founder reviews all six documents at the end.
chosen_option: Two-server modular monolith with three clients
rationale: Adds only what the version 2 targets for scale and recovery require; keeps data in Uzbekistan (EVID-027) at modest cost (EVID-031); notifications and receipts still pass through Telegram abroad (EVID-033)
